sandbox.score_formula: score = 100 x (0.45 x share of steps citing relevant real evidence + 0.35 x distinct relevant observations cited (capped at 6) / 6 + 0.20 x share of steps that were placed in the scene) - 8 per fact that contradicts the account with a real citation (3 without), or 2 per open question the evidence leaves unsettled (1 without); contradictions and open questions together capped at 30 - small fixed penalties for cautions (a door recorded as intact or locked that is used, times from different recordings, times in the text that no cited evidence gives, citations from disputed sources, citations that do not seem to concern the step; each capped). Capped at 25 if any hard physical or timing violation exists. This is a ranking heuristic over checkable facts, not a probability that the scenario is true.

conflicts.claim_a: The Mill Street signal turns green
conflicts.question: Pull the JCT-HM-04 controller phase log and junction phase map for 18:42 to determine whether the Mill Street approach is distinct from the Harbour_EW phase and which approach actually received green.
conflicts.nature_of_conflict: The Prosecutor's argument was more evidence-grounded because both claims report a green onset at the identical 18:42 time with no evidence of a clock offset, a shared phase definition, or a second distinct occurrence, while the Defender conceded no concrete counter-evidence exists.

They must therefore be treated as ONE real-world event, not unrelated occurrences. conflicts.question: Check the underlying video, sensor, or log record for Motorcycle rider around 18:42-18:43 to determine whether only one slide occurred and whether its actual direction was north, down, or both in sequence.
conflicts.nature_of_conflict: The Prosecutor's argument is more evidence-grounded because both claims concern Motorcycle rider's movement within one minute with no evidence of two separate occurrences, while the Defender's north-facing-slope reconciliation is a hypothetical unsupported by any cited fact.

timeline.description: It was maybe twenty to seven when it happened
The collision was at about twenty to seven
The hatchback strikes the motorcycle's front wheel
A dark hatchback is visible from the left, moving fast, entering the junction from the east side of the frame (Harbour Road)
A parked van is visible on the left of Harbour Road in the far distance
The motorcycle falls on its side
A cyclist passes on the left
The motorcycle is about 8 m into the junction
The Mill Street signal turns green
Bus is stopped at the northbound stop line
A motorcycle with a delivery box moves off from the stop line ahead of the bus, accelerating
Call received from caller reporting collision
Collision at Harbour Road / Mill Street junction
